entries.rationale: 13-item edit list is precise, but this rewrites the security contract 11 later tasks implement under an operator-override BLOCK verdict. Prose authoring resolving 18 blockers wants human eyes before it becomes law.

Both plan heuristics prescribe exactly this shape (installExtension end-to-end, then a loader call). Assisted because Decision A changes the shipped reference extension so it no longer installs unchanged, affecting downstream copiers.
Pure pin test over already-exported functions; one new file, zero source modifications. The plan states two assertions start green and that this is expected.
Prose documenting already-decided behavior into three existing docs, with the exact grep strings the test asserts and eight sibling docs suites as the style sample. No runtime risk.

Exact character sets, an exact argv regex, named error codes and a complete failing test. Two new files, no modifications. Novelty held at 3: the token rules must agree with the repo's own YAML parser threat model.
Allowlist tables, constants and precedence are fully decided by Decision B; the task transcribes them and composes t2's checks. Two new files, sibling prior art in manifest-schema.mjs.

Greenfield containment: the named prior art (installSamples) lacks the realpath this module is built around. Introduces a new project-owned payload directory. Symlink, multi-file and Windows edge cases are underspecified.

The plan states --allow-exec, allowExec and exec_consented_at have zero implementation hits in the repo. Fail-closed TTY consent is the human-in-the-loop control itself; a wrong default silently grants execution.

Pattern coverage 1 forces assisted: a hand-rolled line-range YAML splicer with no serializer in the repo and no prior art. Forms 4 and 5 have no test in the plan. Byte-preservation has many indentation and newline edge cases.

The integration point: rewrites ~180 lines of content-install.mjs, deletes three exported functions, and composes four modules that do not exist yet. The plan/apply split and provenance stamping need design care.

Lowest-scoring task (10/20), one point above human-only. Retrofits per-install atomicity onto an installer that writes incrementally, across lib/extensions and cli. All four test fixtures are undefined; strategy confidence is medium.

Mechanical shell:false branch with direct prior art in quality-gate.mjs, but it changes execution semantics of the gate runner every project depends on; the shipped string-form gate must keep working. Test helpers undefined.
